sections.title: Közben: while, during
sections.content: *Közben* means "during" and is used with an event: *Ebéd közben beszélünk.* (We talk during lunch.) *Edzés közben nem iszom.* (I do not drink during training.) It works like *előtt* and *után*: the noun comes first and does not change.

sections.title: Putting a day together
sections.content: Put the three in order to describe a day: *Edzés előtt nem eszem, edzés közben iszom, edzés után pihenek.*

items.english: I do not drink during training.
We go for a walk after the snack.

sections.content: *Közben* needs an event or a meal (*ebéd, edzés, szünet*), not a clock time. Use it for what happens at the same time.
